data.name: Breath Metabolomics
data.abstract: Breath analysis is a pivotal method for biological phenotyping. In a pilot study, 100 experiments with four subjects have been performed to study the reproducibility of this technique.

additional_info.summary: 104 breath metabolomic experiments with 4 subjects have been performed. Average exhalation parameters together with metabolote signal intensities in breath of 1652 chemical compounds were recorded.
additional_info.variable_info:
CO2: CO2 concentration in %
V: Exhaled Volume in L
Q: Exhalation Flowrate in L/min
p: Exhalation Pressure in mbar
X: Chemical Compound Intensity in a.u.
